notes.title: Update Ver 2.0.0
notes.content:
~ Update notice ~

Main update contents
[list]
[*]Added new endings
New endings have been added to the routes of "Elev" and "Lilliana".
When playing each route, you can branch to a new ending by triggering a specific event.

[*]Expanded save feature
Expanded save slots from 3 to 10.
Also, you can now copy save data.
　
※Data will be auto-saved as before.

[*]Shortened tutorial
The tutorial has been shortened from the existing 10 laps to 4 laps.
If you have already cleared the existing tutorial, you can skip it using the "Skip the tutorial" feature added in the v1.0.6 update.

[*]New header design
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684497/c46c4cd1dad3f2f0533195bfa3a1123a4ba40fe3.png[/img]
The header UI displayed during discussions has been completely redesigned.

[*]Added command dialog patterns
Added dialogue patterns for each character when using frequently used commands.

[*]Renewed text for log
The text that appears in the log when using the command has been completely redesigned.
[/list]
Others
[list]
[*]Refined some UI.
[/list]

Please continue to enjoy "Nephilim"!

notes.title: Update Ver 1.0.6
notes.content:
~ Update notice ~

New Features
[list]
[*]Added Filter
Added filter to log.
You can filtering the display by characters or dates.

[*]Added Command "Do nothing"
In order to prevent the problem of missing the timing to speak due to misoperation, 
we have added "Do nothing" to the commands available at the start of a turn.
This will prevent the turn from progressing at the start of the turn unless the player uses any commands.
Operations at the command chain timing will remain the same as before.　

[*]Added Skip the Tutorial
Added "Skip the Tutorial" to Exit menu.
If you have cleared the tutorial at least once, you can skip it.
[/list]

Others
[list]
[*]Fixed so that you can check each NPC's profile data from cast settings
[*]Added notification window when new features are released
[/list]

Please continue to enjoy "Nephilim"!
